about.safetySubtitle: Essential safety guidelines for real and virtual lab work
safetyRules: Perform experiments only in equipped school laboratories under teacher supervision.
Always wear safety goggles and lab coats. Avoid skin or eye contact with acids and alkalis.
Never taste reagents or directly inhale chemical vapors.
Always add acid slowly to water, never water to acid.
All virtual simulations in ChemLab are 100% safe.
